newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jardine to buy 800,000 more of its shares.
newsitem.headline: Jardine to buy 800,000 more of its shares.

text.p: Jardine Davies Inc said on Tuesday its board had approved another share buy back programme involving 800,000 shares, a week after the board approved a similar share scheme.
The board approved on May 14 a resolution to buy 400,000 of its shares at the prevailing market price.
Jardine did not state the reason for the buybacks, but told the Philippine Stock Exchange it would use some of its unrestricted retained earnings to buy the shares for its treasury.
Jardine share price has been stuck at 30 pesos since it announced the first buy-back programme.
Jardine is 72 percent owned by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd.
